page.overview:
Who is Serge?

Developed to replace Rolento, Serge is a bushy eye-browed tough ex-Marine Sergeant who wears an orange beret, khaki-green military fatigues, along with black-leather driver-gloves and paratrooper boots. In addition he also has a palette swap that changes his outfit to a pink color scheme.

Serge's gameplay is similar to Axl and Slash's moveset, which includes the unique ability of blocking incoming attacks.
